title: AutoCanvas automation
description: An AutoCanvas automation definition, version 1. In a repository it lives at .autocanvas/automations/<name>.yml; managed automations use the same format.

^x-.description: Extension data that AutoCanvas does not interpret, for example the canvas layout under x-editor. Preserved on round trips.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the file name without extension.

description.description: What this automation does, shown in the UI.

variables.description: Variables of this automation, readable as ${{ vars.NAME }}. They are added to, and override, variables inherited from the folder.

timeout_minutes.description: Default time limit for each job, unless the job sets its own.

concurrency.description: Whether runs of this automation may overlap. 'single' starts a new run only when no other run of it is active; use it for reconciliations that must not race.

changed_when.description: Expression deciding whether a successful run actually changed something, for example ${{ jobs.check.outputs.changed }}. Runs that changed nothing are collapsed in the history. Unset: every successful run counts as a change.

jobs.description: The jobs of this automation, keyed by job id. Jobs without needs start in parallel.

identifier.description: An id usable in expressions: lower-case letters, digits, '_' and '-', starting with a letter.

condition.description: An expression that decides whether to run, for example ${{ trigger.branch == 'main' }}. The surrounding ${{ }} is optional here.

triggers.description: What starts a run. Without triggers an automation only runs when started by hand or by another automation.

manual.description: Can be started by hand from the UI or API.

push.description: Runs on pushes to the repository this automation lives in (repository automations only).

branches.description: Branch name patterns; unset means all branches.

tags.description: Tag name patterns; unset means tags do not trigger.

paths.description: Only when a changed file matches one of these patterns.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for the cron expression; default UTC.

webhook.description: Can be started by a signed HTTP call to the automation's webhook URL; the request body and headers are available as trigger.body and trigger.headers.

automation.description: Name of the other automation in the same folder, or its path.

oneOf.description: Job id; waits for it to succeed.

on.description: Which outcome of the job lets this one start.

case.description: For a switch job: only when the switch picked the case with this name.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the job id.

type.description: Unset for a job that runs steps on a runner; 'switch' or 'join' for flow control on the canvas.

stepJob.description: A job that runs steps on a runner.

runs_on.description: Runner labels; the job goes to a runner that has all of them.

image.description: Container image the steps run in, for runners that run jobs in containers.

checkout.description: Repositories to clone into the workspace before the steps. A repository automation checks out its own commit by default; false turns that off.

repository.description: 'self', the name of a connected repository, or an https URL.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit; default: the triggering commit for self, else the default branch.

path.description: Directory in the workspace, relative; default: the workspace root.

depth.description: History depth; 0 for the full history. Default 1.

env.description: Environment variables for all steps of the job.

services.description: Containers started next to the job (for example a database), reachable under their key as host name, removed when the job ends.

outputs.description: What the job publishes to later jobs, as name: ${{ steps.ID.outputs.NAME }}. Readable as ${{ jobs.JOB.outputs.NAME }}.

reports.description: Test and coverage reports collected from the workspace after the steps, even when a step failed.

path.description: Glob pattern(s) relative to the workspace.

name.description: Label for the report in the UI; default: the format.

retry.description: Run the job again when it fails.

max_attempts.description: Attempts in total, including the first.

finally.description: Runs once every other job of the run is done, whatever their outcome; ${{ run.status }} tells it how the run went. Cannot have needs.

on_cancel.description: For a finally job: also run when the run is cancelled.

switchJob.description: Evaluates an expression and activates the first matching case; jobs that need the switch with that case run, the others are skipped.

name.description: Case name that dependent jobs refer to with needs[].case.

when.description: Value the expression must equal (compared as text).

default.description: Taken when no other case matches. At most one case is the default.

joinJob.description: Waits for its needs and passes through; groups branches on the canvas.

id.description: Id for reading this step's outputs as ${{ steps.ID.outputs.NAME }}.

continue_on_error.description: A failure of this step does not fail the job.

run.description: Script to run; may contain expressions.

shell.description: Shell to run it with; default: bash if available, else sh (pwsh on Windows runners).

oneOf.description: A step of a built-in or plugin node type.

type.description: Node type, for example http_request or docker_build.

with.description: Inputs of the node type; which ones exist is defined by the node type.

outputs.description: Extra outputs of this step, as name: expression.

preset.description: A preset with a known image, environment and readiness check.

version.description: Version of the preset, for example 17.

image.description: Container image, instead of a preset.

ready.description: Command run inside the service until it succeeds before the steps start; default: the preset's check.
